title: H125 / AS350 B3 (2B1) Quick Reference
intro: For training use only. This is an informal quick reference of selected H125 / AS350 B3 (2B1) RFM limitations and operating numbers. Always use the official RFM / QRH as primary reference.

items.label: VNE power on / power off (Hp = 0)
lines: VNE power on: 155 kt IAS at Hp = 0.
VNE power off: 125 kt IAS at Hp = 0.

items.label: Cold weather corrections
lines: OAT < -30 °C: reduce VNE power on by 10 kt.
OAT < -20 °C: reduce VNE power off by 20 kt (minimum 65 kt).

items.label: Power-off
lines: Minimum power-off Nr: 320 rpm.

items.label: Normal operating range
lines: Normal Nr range (power-on): 375–405 rpm.

items.label: Aural warnings
lines: Low Nr aural warning: ≤ 360 rpm.
High Nr aural warning: ≥ 410 rpm.

items.label: Arriel 2B1 (AEO)
lines: Maximum continuous: 92.7 %.
Takeoff rating: 100 %.
Transient (5 s): 104 %.
100 % torque = 535 kW at NR 386 rpm.
Use of the takeoff rating torque range has no time limit.

items.label: Engine takeoff rating
lines: Use of the engine takeoff rating range is limited to 5 continuous minutes.
Heating and demisting are forbidden above the engine maximum continuous rating (Ng or t4).

items.label: Ng (gas generator)
lines: Minimum stabilized rating: 67 %.
Maximum continuous: ΔNg = -4 % (Ng 97.1 % at Hp = 0, ISA).
Takeoff rating range: ΔNg = -4 % to 0 %; maximum takeoff: ΔNg = 0 % (Ng 101.1 %).
Maximum transient: ΔNg = +1 % (Ng 102.3 %, 5 s).

items.label: Nf (power turbine)
lines: Minimum: 349 rpm; normal operating range: 349–418 rpm.
Maximum continuous: 418 rpm.
Maximum transient: 450 rpm (5 s).
NR 386 rpm = Nf 39 158 rpm.

items.label: Start
lines: Max continuous during start: 750 °C.
Transient during start (10 s): 865 °C.

items.label: Flight
lines: Max continuous in flight: 849 °C.
Takeoff rating range: 849–915 °C; maximum takeoff rating: 915 °C.
Maximum transient: 941 °C (20 s).

items.label: Internal weight limits
lines: Maximum permissible internal weight in flight: 2250 kg (4961 lb).
Maximum permissible internal weight for IGE take-off and landing: 2250 kg (4961 lb).

items.label: Cargo compartments
lines: RH cargo compartment: max 100 kg.
LH cargo compartment: max 120 kg.
Rear cargo compartment: max 80 kg.

items.label: Cabin floor
lines: Rear cabin floor: max 310 kg.
Forward left cabin floor: max 150 kg.

items.label: Landing / rotor stop slopes
lines: Nose up: 10°.
Nose down: 6°.
Sideways: 8°.

items.label: Engine start
lines: Prohibited if snow or ice has collected in or around the engine air intake.

items.label: Engine oil
lines: Maximum oil temperature: 115 °C (caution range -10 °C to 0 °C).
Minimum oil temperature before power application: 0 °C (oil 5 cSt).
Minimum oil pressure (Ng ≥ 70 %): 1.1 bar (16 psi); caution ranges 1.1–2 bar and 6–9.8 bar.
Maximum oil pressure: 9.8 bar (142 psi).

items.label: Electrical
lines: Maximum voltage: 31.5 V (rated range 26–29 V).
Maximum continuous current: 150 A.

items.label: Fuel anti-icing
lines: Fuel anti-icing additive mandatory if OAT < -20 °C and the fuel does not contain a freezing inhibitor.

items.label: Emergency floatation gear (SUP.17)
lines: Emergency landing on water only; no takeoff after landing on water.
Max IAS with gear stowed and armed or inflated: 135 kt (250 km/h) power on; 100 kt (185 km/h) with torque below 40 %.
Maximum altitude for float inflation: 6600 ft (2000 m).
Gear must be armed below 400 ft (122 m) above water.
Minimum weight with OAT < 0 °C: 1480 kg (3263 lb).
Recommended inflation IAS: below 80 kt (148 km/h).

items.label: External loads (SUP.12 sling / SUP.13 swing) — only the installation fitted applies
lines: Cargo swing (SUP.13, 13.1, 13.2 — suspended pyramid frame with a SIREN or ON-BOARD release unit): max 1400 kg (3086 lb).
Cargo sling (SUP.12 — Breeze Eastern release unit and hook, P/N 17149-1): max 750 kg (1660 lb).
Maximum all-up weight with external load: 2800 kg (6173 lb) or the OGE-hover maximum, whichever is lower.
Maximum IAS with external load: 80 kt (148 km/h).
Non-human external cargo only; jettisonable loads only.

items.label: Hoist (SUP.18 / 19)
lines: Maximum load on cable: 136 kg (300 lb) (SUP.18) or 204 kg (450 lb) (SUP.19).
Minimum crew: pilot and hoist operator. Landing with a load on the cable is prohibited.
Hoist failure return: VNE 60 kt (111 km/h) with the cable slightly inclined.

items.label: Bambi bucket (SUP.52)
lines: Capacity 1225 litres.
VNE 90 kt (167 km/h) empty; 80 kt (148 km/h) full or partly filled.

items.label: Sand filter (SUP.14)
lines: Heating and demisting OFF when P2 is ON.
P2 OFF in visible moisture with OAT below 0 °C.
Flight in falling snow only with the sand filter installed and P2 OFF.

items.label: AFCS SFIM 85 T 31 (SUP.16)
lines: Minimum height for hands-off operation: 400 ft (120 m).
Disengaged on the ground except for checks; no engagement before takeoff if the trim test is not satisfactory.

items.label: Dual hydraulic system (SUP.23)
lines: Do not exceed a load factor that lights LIMIT.
HYD1 or HYD2 with SERVO: bank below 30°, IAS below 110 kt (204 km/h) or VNE if less.

items.label: Increased internal gross weight (SUP.28)
lines: Maximum internal weight in flight and for IGE takeoff and landing: 2370 kg (5225 lb).

items.label: Approved operations
lines: Approved for day and night VFR.
Flight in icing conditions is not permitted.

items.label: Crew & occupancy
lines: Minimum crew: 1 pilot in the right seat.
Maximum persons on board (including crew): 6.

items.label: Prohibited operations (selected)
lines: Aerobatic manoeuvres: prohibited.
Intentional engine power reduction in flight using the twist grip: prohibited (except where explicitly allowed for training/emergency procedures in the RFM).
